repairs.problem: Stylesheet-only important anchor height/top changes left one stale half of an owned footer rule.
repairs.genericFix: Track authored sizing declarations and release paired anchor overrides when the source contract or resolved top/height pair changes.
repairs.contract: Keep page top/height inline values and priorities intact; the button must remain inside the current footer and clickable.

repairs.problem: Stylesheet/inherited-variable zero-height collapse was masked by translation expansion rules.
repairs.genericFix: Fingerprint authored sizing inputs and resolved referenced custom properties; synchronously read unmasked height as a zero-height fallback. Release obsolete expansion and preserve dormant owners for a later reopen.
repairs.contract: Class, inherited variable and style-text collapse reach zero in watching and paused sessions; reopen keeps existing translation ownership without new paused collection.

repairs.problem: Moving structured prose elements into a plugin text wrapper broke page direct-child selectors.
repairs.genericFix: Retain original structured prose elements in their current parent and append a wrapping translation row.
repairs.contract: Keep original nodes, direct-child CSS, order and page edits; page wrapping, split/normalize, transfer, insert and delete survive restore, including repeated restore and mode switches.

repairs.problem: Responsive ancestor class/style changes left image dimensions and crop masked by stale plugin rules.
repairs.genericFix: Fingerprint authored media dimensions/crop and containing row layout policy; retire media overrides when those inputs change.
repairs.contract: Apply the page new image height and object-fit while preserving original image node, source and attributes.

observations: No new horizontal document overflow, clipping or squeezed-label candidates were measured in the selected page views; all current source text/link values, node order and retained identity checks passed after restore.

GitHub initial final capture caught an incomplete hydrated commit list. A fresh same-URL capture waited10seconds for stabilization and reproduced120 source units and118 translations; final comparison uses that capture.

Apple final source showed its region recommendation banner. Its additional source units/vertical offset and source-owned removal already existed before translation; current-source restore checks preserve the page state.

limitations: Eight live webpages were resampled; the earlier70-page audit was not rerun.
Chromium functional tests use the installed extension. Firefox tests use native Gecko and fresh packaged content through the repository existing browser shim.

Cross-origin stylesheets that disallow CSSOM inspection cannot provide a complete authored policy fingerprint. Zero-height collapse has an unmasked computed-style fallback and anchor pairing has resolved-geometry fallback; this does not establish coverage of every opaque stylesheet sizing/crop change.

CSSOM rule edits without an observable DOM/style/link/media/resize event are outside the update trigger contract. Container/scope conditional rules are not comprehensively modeled by the source policy fingerprint.

Head stylesheet text changes update owned layout rules but do not independently request fresh source collection. The collapse/reopen contract was verified for settled independent triggers. Rapidly mixing a pending class/variable visibility rescan with a head-only collapse/reopen can encounter a collection-trigger gap. A max-height control reproduced the same gap in both saved before/final sources and both engines; this broader scheduling boundary was not expanded in the current repair.
Rich replacement retains its existing safe-skeleton sanitization and original-node restoration contract; unrelated typography boundaries were not expanded.
Translation cache was reused where possible; page sampling does not imply an uncached upstream request for every view.
